latestVersion.changelog:
Editor for Beginners — Initial Release

- Launches an AI-assisted video editor for first-time creators: upload, edit via simple prompts, and export polished 1080p MP4 clips without complex software.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (mp4, mov, avi, webm, and more) and common audio/image files.
- Automatically handles backend setup, authentication with anonymous tokens, and session creation.
- Streamlines common actions: trim, add music/text, check credits, preview/edit timeline, and export.
- Includes robust error handling, cloud GPU rendering, and workflow tips for best results.
